cards.title: Strategic Opportunity & Market Impact
cards.botDialogue: Welcome! I am Aayam. Let's look at the strategic business opportunity for AIS ABAP & CDS AI Debug Studio - Intelligent SAP ADT Debugging. Here is how we transform operational velocity.
bullets: ST22 short dumps are cryptic; developers dig through runtime logs just to understand a crash.
Pinpointing the failing line and root cause depends on scarce, experienced ABAP expertise.
CDS activation errors, package creation and transports force constant switching between SAP GUI and ADT.

cards.title: Enterprise Process Bottlenecks
cards.botDialogue: Examining the core friction points in current operations. Notice the process bottlenecks that create revenue leakage.
bullets: Disconnected data silos across regional plants and commercial entities.
High variance between physical operations and digital ledger postings.
Heavy developer dependency on proprietary legacy custom code.

cards.title: Clean Core Solution Architecture
cards.botDialogue: Here is our decoupled Clean Core architecture. Notice how SAP BTP handles high-velocity transactions while keeping S/4HANA untouched.

cards.title: End-to-End Execution Flow
cards.botDialogue: Notice our 3-step automated flow. From transaction intake to verified settlement, the process is fast and auditable.

steps.title: 1. Select Dump or Describe CDS - Developer picks an ST22 dump or types a plain-English CDS prompt in the studio.
steps.desc: 1. Select Dump or Describe CDS - Developer picks an ST22 dump or types a plain-English CDS prompt in the studio.

steps.title: 2. AI Reads & Reasons via ADT - The BTP agent calls ADT REST through Cloud Connector; the AI correlates the stack trace and drafts a verified patch.
steps.desc: 2. AI Reads & Reasons via ADT - The BTP agent calls ADT REST through Cloud Connector; the AI correlates the stack trace and drafts a verified patch.

steps.title: 3. Confirm & Push Live - Developer confirms target package and transport; the fix is pushed and activated in SAP.
steps.desc: 3. Confirm & Push Live - Developer confirms target package and transport; the fix is pushed and activated in SAP.
